slides.sub: He was 16. His sister drew the logo on the kitchen table.

text: One week after his GCSEs finished,
Andy C borrowed £1,000 from his uncle.
His sister drew a ram on a piece of paper.
The name came from his star sign.
slides.sub: The third record they pressed became the anthem of a generation.

text: Origin Unknown. Andy C + Ant Miles.
Drums from a free CD in a magazine.
slides.sub: "31 seconds." Nobody was ready for it.

quote: rave music wanted to make you happy.
slides.note: Sparse. Ominous. No euphoria. Just weight. That was darkcore. That was the beginning of drum and bass.

text: Both landing at the exact same moment.
When it works, they stop being two songs.
slides.sub: Andy C won Best DnB DJ every year from 2009 to 2018. Ten years in a row.

text: First drum and bass act to do it.
